connector.name: Local YDB MCP
connector.registryDescription: Operate local-ydb deployments through local or SSH-backed MCP tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package local-ydb-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the astandrik account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: LOCAL_YDB_TOOLKIT_CONFIG
env.description: Optional path to a local-ydb-toolkit config JSON file.

env.name: LOCAL_YDB_MCP_CONTENT_FORMAT
env.description: Optional LLM-facing tool response text format. Use toon to prefer TOON for the second text content block, with JSON fallback if TOON cannot round-trip losslessly; omit or set json for pretty JSON. MCP JSON-RPC and structuredContent stay JSON.
